snippet.title: Age of Clicks - Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a new and unique strategy game called Age of Clicks. It seems that the two genres of Clicker and Global Strategy can be combined. Now, you can use your straight finger to make a click that will give your country money and resources. A click that can capture enemy territory! 

👇 SUPPORT THE PROJECT: 
🎮 The game is available on the Steam (Best way to help us!):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4804480/Age_of_Clicks/

📱 The game is available on the Google Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.rbs.aocl
